description:
Reads ONE incoming supplier invoice and returns a job id for polling.

Use when: the user has a single invoice (PDF, photo, scan, XML e-invoice or QR bill) and wants supplier, invoice number, dates, amounts, VAT or line items extracted.
Do not use when: the user asks to ISSUE an invoice, to send a payment, or to post entries into DATEV/1C — this tool only reads documents. For several documents call it once per document; the returned job ids can be polled independently.

Side effects and cost: the document is downloaded and queued. XML and QR invoices are parsed by code and cost nothing; scans and photos cost 0.07 EUR per page, charged to the prepaid balance. Not idempotent: each call creates a new job and a new charge for scans.

Parameters: file_url must be a public https link to a single document on duebuddy.work (upload first via the cabinet); country is a two-letter code that selects the parsing profile and changes field names and tax rules, not the price. api_key may be omitted when the server was added with an X-Api-Key header.

Returns: {ok, job_id, status}. Next step: call get_result with that job_id.

api_key.description: DueBuddy API key (starts with dd_). Omit it when the server was added with an X-Api-Key header or DUEBUDDY_API_KEY is set; the call returns api_key_required when no key is available anywhere.
api_key.title: Api Key

country.description: Two-letter parsing profile that selects field names and tax rules: de, fr, it, pl, ru, kz, by, us, ae, sa, ua, ge. Defaults to de. Does not change the price; a wrong profile returns plausible but mislabelled fields.
country.title: Country

file_url.description: Public https URL of exactly ONE invoice file hosted on duebuddy.work, for example https://duebuddy.work/files/invoice-218.pdf. Allowed endings: .pdf, .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .xml, .xlsx, .xls, .csv. http links and other hosts are rejected with an error; upload the file in the DueBuddy cabinet first to get a link.
file_url.title: File Url

name: parse_invoice
title: Parse one incoming invoice
